entries.zh: 巴不得；热切盼望而不得（amar no poder：爱而不能）
entries.en: to long for eagerly; to wish ardently for what one cannot have

entries.zh: 搔；抓痒
entries.en: to scratch (an itch)
entries.notes: L 栏 "A Masar" 为 amasar 之误断或残笔，与 H 搔（抓挠）不完全对应，据 H/M/R 三栏定释义。

entries.zh: 用手揉搓成圆团（如搓圆子）
entries.en: to knead with the hands as when making small round dough balls

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕用手揉蜡搓成小丸
entries.en: to knead wax with the hands into little pellets (gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: H 与 R 栏均空，仅据 L（揉蜡成丸）与 M 音 Lō̃ chiy 推断，或为「捼𣐀」类揉蜡词。

entries.zh: 打面浆；揉面（调制面团/面糊）
entries.en: to knead the dough; to mix the flour paste

entries.zh: 龙涎；龙涎香原料（抹香鲸肠内分泌物，马尼拉贸易香料）
entries.en: ambergris (raw substance)

entries.zh: 龙涎香；名贵龙涎香料
entries.en: precious ambergris (perfume/incense)

entries.zh: 奢；骄奢（qº=que，soberuio=soberbio 骄傲）
entries.en: ambitious, i.e. arrogant/proud; extravagant

entries.zh: 奢华；炫富摆阔而实贫
entries.en: luxurious, ostentatious in display though poor

entries.zh: 奢侈；挥霍糜费
entries.en: extravagant, prodigal in spending
entries.notes: M 栏附有旁注 «Balchy.»（可能为吕宋土语借词对照），展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 奋；志向远大（雄心勃勃）
entries.en: ambitious, aspiring, striving

entries.zh: 舐口舐舌；舔嘴弄舌，贪馋觊觎（在欲求之事上得意忘形）
entries.en: to lick lips and tongue in greed; one who preens himself over his pretensions
entries.notes: H 字序与 M/R 音读存在错位（R 四音对三字），词义依赖推断。

entries.zh: 志；有志者（志于所求之人）
entries.en: aspiring one; pretender, claimant

entries.zh: 志气；抱负宏大
entries.en: ambition; great aspiration

entries.zh: 志向；心向往之（心随所求而动）
entries.en: aspiration; the heart set on what it pursues

entries.zh: 目中无人；自高自大，无所畏惮（q nada le harza＝无可使之却步）
entries.en: so self-exalted that nothing restrains him; arrogant beyond check
entries.notes: H「見大」或为「自大/见大」之抄形，L harza（har-te？）拼写存疑，词义依赖推断。

entries.zh: 骄奢人；骄傲奢侈之徒
entries.en: a proud and extravagant person

entries.zh: 目空自大；眼高于顶（双目随所求而扬）
entries.en: haughty, with eyes lifted after his pretensions; overweening ambition

entries.zh: 兼；两者兼有
entries.en: both; to hold two things at once

entries.zh: 兼又；兼而并之，一并（蒹当作兼，形近讹）
entries.en: both together; jointly, at the same time (moreover)
